# Documentation & paperwork
The following forms should be available for use within Science:
- [bold]Mech Authorization Form[/bold]: Official documentation of mech construction, including the mech's name, purpose, and authorization. - [bold]Borgification Consent Form[/bold]: Official documentation of a crew member's consent to be converted into a cyborg. - [bold]Cyborg Conversion Form[/bold]: Records individual to be converted, the new chassis, authorization, and reasoning. - [bold]Item Request Form[/bold]: documentation of upgrades, distributed boards, and recipients. - [bold]Anomalous Host Consent Form[/bold]: written informed consent for crew hosting anomalies. - [bold]Anomaly Research Log[/bold]: Documentation of anomaly research, including the anomaly's location, type, and any relevant information.
All forms should be filed promptly in departmental records and made available for review by the RD, Command, or Internal Affairs.
